name: Holmberg II (Hubble)
blurb: Holmberg II, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc43051-hubble
story: Huge bubbles of glowing gas punctuate this dwarf galaxy, blown out by the winds and supernova explosions of massive stars, among dense star-forming regions and barren stretches.

claims.text: Holmberg II is a dwarf irregular galaxy
It is dominated by huge bubbles of glowing gas, sites of ongoing star formation
The bubbles were blown by stellar winds and supernovae; the galaxy is a patchwork of dense star-forming regions and barren areas
UGC-4305-1 is the Holmberg II-1 pointing of program 10605
